title: TagDuel LP Discord projection seat matrix

implementation.behavior: For each initial active seat, the public Discord payload shows the shared team LP totals [4500,3500], all four physical hands remain UID-private, only the current representative receives the action menu, the partner sees no action menu, and an End Phase action is processed through handleTagComponent with a revision increment and unchanged shared LP.
implementation.validation: Discord builders and handler are exercised offline with payload validation and an isolated SQLite database; no live bot session.

limitations: The test exercises Discord payload builders and handleTagComponent offline; it does not connect to a live Discord guild.
LP values are seeded from a trusted pipeline result; no new card is registered or certified.
